requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: A producer could accept incompatible linked native/reference currencies or hide an implicit conversion while returning a superficially valid payload.

risk_surfaces.reason: Linked currency roles must reject deliberately incompatible values at the canonical producer boundary.
Every normative source bullet must survive as an explicit obligation.
Exact-head evidence must remain bound to the material candidate.
Canonical documentation must reflect the implemented contract without provider activation.

negative_controls.failure_mode: The canonical producer could accept incompatible source/destination currency references and emit a converted output for a divergent linked relation.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: The canonical producer could accept incompatible source/destination currency references and emit a converted output for a divergent linked relation.
negative_controls.procedure: Call the canonical currency conversion producer with deliberately incompatible linked source and destination currencies, then inspect rejection and absence of converted output.
negative_controls.expected: The producer rejects the incompatible linked values and writes or emits no invalid converted relation.
negative_controls.observed: Source and target currency mismatches are rejected at the producer boundary and no converted output is returned.

negative_controls.expected: All normative bullets are represented explicitly and reference-only bullets are not promoted into requirements.
negative_controls.observed: Fifteen normative candidates map to fifteen obligations; eleven covered requirements and four explicit non-covered dispositions are present.
